description: One saved version of the presentation. It has a folder of its own under `versions/`. The folder has this file and copies of the presentation's two files as they were saved. The `<time>` in its folder's name is when the version was saved. A suffix follows it.

markdownpoint.description: The file's format version in quotes, such as "1.0". Its major and minor numbers each have at most nine digits and no leading zero.

number.description: The version's number. It is one more than the highest version number when this version was saved. A version can replace another. It then takes that version's number.

name.description: The name the author gave the version. It is one line that isn't blank and has no control characters or line breaks. Without it, the version has no name.
